findings.title: Missing `key` prop on `GrafanaRuleListItem` inside `.map()`
findings.body: In `FilterViewResults`, when replacing `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} ... />` with `<GrafanaRuleListItem ... />` inside `rules.map(...)`, the `key={key}` prop was dropped. Rendering list items in an array without a `key` causes React console warnings and can lead to incorrect component state reconciliation when the filtered rule list updates.

findings.title: Silence notifications menu action does nothing in the alert list view
findings.body: In the new alert list view (`GrafanaRuleListItem`), `RuleActionsButtons` is called with only `promRule` and `rule` (`rulerRule`) is `undefined`. `AlertRuleMenu` now uses `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` to enable and render the "Silence notifications" menu item, which calls `handleSilence={() => setShowSilenceDrawer(true)}`. However, `RuleActionsButtons` renders `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` conditionally on `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`. Because `rule` is `undefined` when rendered from the list view, clicking "Silence notifications" sets `showSilenceDrawer` to `true` but the drawer never renders.

findings.title: Pause and Delete menu items are hidden in the alert list view because `rulerRule` is undefined
findings.body: In `AlertRuleMenu`, `canPause` and `canDelete` were updated to compute abilities from `promRule` via `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` when `rulerRule` is not provided (as in `GrafanaRuleListItem`). However, the JSX conditions for rendering those menu items still require `rulerRule`: line 123 checks `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` and line 165 checks `canDelete && rulerRule`. Because `GrafanaRuleListItem` only passes `promRule` (leaving `rulerRule` undefined), neither Pause nor Delete will ever be rendered in the alert rule list view for Grafana-managed rules.
